name: EnglishBuddy
tagline: A friendly conversation. A little better English, every day.
description: Open EnglishBuddy and start chatting in English right away. Buddy keeps the conversation going with short, friendly replies and one natural follow-up question. Get gentle, optional language notes that show your original words, a clearer version, and a simple explanation. Save useful expressions from your conversations to a searchable phrasebook, then bring them back into practice. Choose a comfortable English level, try everyday situations such as a cafe or work conversation, and return to saved chats. Conversations, preferences, and saved phrases use your private Anna Storage. The app uses Anna's built-in AI with your existing quota; no separate account, model API key, or bundled Executa is needed. This version offers text conversation practice, not voice or pronunciation assessment.
changelog: First release: immediate English chat, gentle language notes, saved conversations, a searchable phrasebook, practice topics, and export.
